description: Tronçons de lignes ferroviaires is a dataset listed in Open Data Mons, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Assets Management. Ce jeu de données reprend tous les tronçons de ligne ferroviaire à l'échelle nationale ← Retour au catalogue complet. Coverage: Mons. The portal files it under Mobility. Its keywords are gare, mobilité, train, sncb. The portal shows 1,210 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2025-07-16 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open licentie CC0 - Universeel (https://infrabel.opendatasoft.com/pages/license/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-opendata-mons-be-portal.
